title: Personal rope lessons shaped around your curiosity.
intro: Private sessions create room for questions, pacing, and personal goals, from first knots to deeper partner communication.
bullets: One-on-one instruction for absolute beginners or students refining specific skills.
Couples sessions focused on communication, confidence, and shared vocabulary.
Small private groups for friends or partners who want a quieter learning environment.
expectText: Private sessions are shaped around the person or people attending. The pace, topic, and depth can be adjusted before and during the session.
If you are not sure where to begin, the session can start with simple questions about experience level, curiosity, comfort, and learning goals.
notOffered: Techniques outside the teacher's comfort or training
Sessions without clear consent, sobriety, and communication
practicalText: Exact location, timing, access details, and preparation notes can be shared after inquiry.
Students are welcome to ask questions before committing to a session.
clothingText: Wear clothing that allows movement and helps you feel comfortable. Avoid hard zippers, sharp accessories, or anything that makes body awareness difficult.
safetyText: Private sessions begin with conversation about goals, boundaries, access needs, and risk awareness.
Activities can be adjusted or paused at any time. Add studio-specific limits, cancellation policies, and screening details here.
beforeText: Email with your experience level, what you would like to learn, and anything you want the teacher to know about access needs, boundaries, or injuries.
Please include only what you are comfortable sharing by email.
bookingSteps: Send an inquiry with your goals and any practical questions.
Agree on the session format, timing, and location details.
Confirm any preparation notes, payment details, and cancellation policy.
cancellationText: Add the studio cancellation and deposit policy here once booking logistics are finalized.

faqItems.question: Can sessions be tailored for beginners?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Private sessions can start with basic rope handling, communication, and simple floor-based ties.

faqItems.question: Can couples or small groups book together?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Add details here about group size, pricing, and what information to include when inquiring.

faqItems.question: What should I share before booking?
faqItems.answer: Share your experience level, learning goals, boundaries, access needs, and any relevant injuries only if you are comfortable doing so.
